alert_description:
What fired: One user was denied permission five or more times within an hour across host management operations.

Why it matters: A burst of denials means an account is probing what it is allowed to do, typical of a stolen low-privilege credential. Assessed severity: Low.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1069.001 - Permission Groups Discovery: Local Groups (TA0007 - Discovery).

Investigate:
  - Read events_seen for the exact host log lines and the acting user / source.
  - Confirm with the ESXi owner whether the change or access was planned (change ticket, maintenance window).
  - Pivot on the alert's key (esxi_host, actor_user) and the source IP to firewall, VPN, and identity activity in the same window.
  - Check the same host for other ESXi alerts (shell enabled, uncommon commands, syslog changes, VM power-offs) that would make this part of a ransomware chain.
